record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace absolute padded-slot position IDs with chronological ranks among nonpadding tokens: padding remains 0 and real or masked positions receive 1 through sequence length. Reuse the existing positional embedding table without changing its shape or parameterization. This may share positional evidence across different history lengths more effectively on predominantly short sequences. Derive ranks solely from nonpadding locations, including mask tokens; preserve topology, loss, optimizer and appended-mask readout, and apply the same mapping during inference.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, chronological nonpadding ranks may share positional evidence across short histories of different lengths. Include mask tokens in the ranks and keep padding at zero. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and inference use identical features without changing embedding shapes, topology, readout, loss or optimizer.
